findings.description: V2PairHook.afterSwap(address,PoolKey,IPoolManager.SwapParams,BalanceDelta,bytes) (src/V2PairHook.sol#196-207) is an IHooks callback (0xb47b2fb1) that never compares msg.sender against poolManager. Anyone can call it with an arbitrary PoolKey and arbitrary hookData.

findings.description: V2PairHook (src/V2PairHook.sol#21-284) declares permission `beforeAddLiquidity` (bit 11, BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeAddLiquidity` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.
evidence: V2PairHook (src/V2PairHook.sol#21-284) declares permission `beforeAddLiquidity` (bit 11, BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeAddLiquidity` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.

V2PairHook (src/V2PairHook.sol#21-284) declares permission `beforeInitialize` (bit 13, BEFORE_INITIALIZE_FLAG) but provides no working `beforeInitialize` implementation. The PoolManager will call it on every matching pool operation and the call will revert, making the pool unusable for that operation.

findings.title: V2PairHook (src/V2PairHook.sol#21-284) declares custom-accounting permissions: `afterSwapReturnDelta` (bit 2), `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3)
findings.description: V2PairHook (src/V2PairHook.sol#21-284) declares custom-accounting permissions: `afterSwapReturnDelta` (bit 2), `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3). The hook can alter settled amounts, which raises its risk tier under the framework's custom-math and price-impact triggers and means differential output comparison (invariant I2) does not apply — the harness substitutes price monotonicity.
evidence: V2PairHook (src/V2PairHook.sol#21-284) declares custom-accounting permissions: `afterSwapReturnDelta` (bit 2), `beforeSwapReturnDelta` (bit 3). The hook can alter settled amounts, which raises its risk tier under the framework's custom-math and price-impact triggers and means differential output comparison (invariant I2) does not apply — the harness substitutes price monotonicity.

dimensions.name: Complexity
dimensions.bracketLabel: 1-2 callbacks, no branching on hook state
evidence: The hook implements callbacks with non-trivial structure. This establishes a floor only; hookrisk has no dedicated complexity metric yet.

dimensions.name: Custom math
dimensions.bracketLabel: A custom curve or invariant function
evidence: Custom accounting implies a custom curve or non-standard settlement arithmetic.

dimensions.name: External dependencies
evidence: Not measured: no detector for external-call-in-swap-path yet.

dimensions.name: TVL potential
evidence: Declared in hookrisk.toml. hookrisk does not measure tvlPotential.

dimensions.name: Team maturity
dimensions.bracketLabel: Unproven: no prior production deployments, or deployments lacking audits and operational rigor; new, anonymous, or no public track record
evidence: Declared in hookrisk.toml. hookrisk does not measure teamMaturity.

dimensions.name: Upgradeability
evidence: Not measured: no detector for upgradeable-hook (needs blocksec, which did not run); selfdestruct requires blocksec, which did not run.

dimensions.name: Price impacting behavior
dimensions.bracketLabel: Returns a swap delta (custom curve or NoOp), or adjusts fees without a ceiling
evidence: A returns-delta permission lets the hook alter settled amounts, which is the framework’s definition of price-impacting behaviour.
